title: Supplemental Benefits and Member Cost Share on a Special Needs Plan
content:
A package in the Special Needs Plans category carries the supplemental benefits it fixes, and those benefits are what most members call about: the allowance card, the transport, the dental, vision and hearing allowances, the meals after a hospital stay and the hours of in-home support.

(a) The allowance loaded each quarter, the trips a year, the meals after discharge and the in-home hours are the package's figures and are never varied case by case, however sympathetic the circumstances.

(b) An unused supplemental benefit does not carry into the next plan year, and a member who has not used their transport by December is told the date it resets rather than promised an extension.

(c) The dental, vision and hearing allowances here are embedded in the plan and are not an optional rider; a member of a Special Needs Plan holds no separate rider and should not be sold one.

(d) Where a member's package gives no in-home support and they need it, the plan says so plainly and refers them to the state's own programmes rather than implying the plan might cover it.

(e) Cost share on medical and drug benefits is the package's, except that a member in a protected Medicaid category owes nothing at all.

## Basis Q and A

**A member asks for a larger allowance on the card than their package carries, their circumstances that quarter being hard.** The figure is the package's and is not varied case by case, under clause (a).

**A member has covered transport trips left in December and asks whether they may be used in January.** They may not. An unused supplemental benefit does not carry into the next plan year, and the member is told the date it resets, under clause (b).

**A member asks to buy a dental rider so as to have a dental allowance.** They hold that allowance already, embedded in their Special Needs Plan, and hold no separate rider; they should not be sold one, under clause (c).

**A member in a protected Medicaid category asks what they will owe for a specialist visit.** Nothing at all, under clause (e), which holds whatever cost share the package would otherwise carry for the service.
